Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
I was starting to go crazy there... just like the new Kiasyd.

New rule: Cold Iron Vulnerability.

Man... so some weapons are going to be designated as COLD IRON...
uhuh. Great... Boring. Someone with this weakness hit by it takes Agg
damage... Uhuh. So... what about a bastard sword? Are we going to
reprint this card and call it Cold Iron? Errata time LSJ?

In clan disc. are Dom, Myt and Obt. Damn... I should have kept those
Obt cards I pawned off... I traded it all away cause I hated Lasombra
(not the person, the vampires). Oh, and they're considered Sabbat.

Supposedly mix well with Lasombra and Malks and Tremere... I could
also see mixing with Ventrue, !Ventrue, and Giovanni but why bother...
Except that the previewed card is

Beatrice L'Angou; 5 cap Aus, Dom, Nec, MYT. Cold Iron Vulnerability.

Supposedly the lowest cap Kiasyd in the new expansion... so... I'm not
too sure...

Slap her in a Giovanni deck. Some of those guys have Aus. Most have
Dom and Nec. Not too sure what you can do with a Dom/Aus/Nec deck
anyhow, but I'm sure you're bound to have lots of fun allies and
retainers with that deck! Shame the only good ally/retainer is one fed
to a Warghoul... :)

Alright. Enough from me for one day. Time to go back to... um...
whatever it is I do when I'm not lurking.

~SV
